# Network security

> Capturing, inspecting, and monitoring network traffic, and the references for securing networks and their protocols.

Part of the [domain list](README.md). 2 resources in 1 section. Running and troubleshooting a network day to day sits in Networking and connectivity; port scanners sit in Offensive security.

For references, how-to guides, and learning paths on this subject, see the TeamStarWolf library's [matching domain page](https://github.com/TeamStarWolf/TeamStarWolf/blob/main/hubs/network-security.md).

## Traffic capture and analysis

What is on the wire?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Wireshark](https://www.wireshark.org/) | Wireshark Foundation | Captures packets and decodes them protocol by protocol for close inspection; installers for Windows and macOS, with source for other systems. | Tool | Free |
| [Zeek](https://zeek.org/) | The Zeek Project | Open source, scriptable network monitor, originally developed under the name Bro. | Tool | Free |
| [Nmap](https://nmap.org/) | Nmap Project | Free and open source security scanner for port scanning and network exploration. | Tool | Free |

Listed here from another domain: Nmap ([Offensive security](offensive-security.md#network-scanning)).
